issues.text: enableSqlExpressions returns false on every path; the feature flag's read result is computed and then discarded.
issues.zh: enableSqlExpressions 每條路徑都回傳 false，feature flag 的讀取結果被計算後丟棄

issues.text: The disable guard is only placed on the new parser path; the default path is blocked only by the stub failing, and the resulting error message wrongly blames the user's SQL.
issues.zh: 停用的 guard 只放在新 parser 路徑上，預設路徑靠 stub 失敗擋下來，錯誤訊息會怪到使用者的 SQL 上

issues.text: No test pins down the new 'SQL expressions are disabled' behavior.
issues.zh: 沒有任何測試釘住「SQL expression 已停用」這個新行為

issues.text: enableSqlExpressions: the name promises something the function doesn't do, and it uses an inverted boolean name.
issues.zh: enableSqlExpressions：名稱承諾的事情與行為不符，且用了反向命名的布林

issues.text: (*DB).TablesList has no call sites and shares its name with the package-level sql.TablesList.
issues.zh: (*DB).TablesList 沒有任何呼叫點，而且與同 package 的 sql.TablesList 同名

issues.text: DuckDB has been removed from the tree, but comments, the feature toggle description, and frontend copy still mention DuckDB.
issues.zh: DuckDB 已經從 tree 裡移除，但註解、feature toggle 說明與前端文案還在講 DuckDB

open_questions.text: Is this disablement permanent, or will it be re-enabled via the sqlExpressions toggle once a replacement SQL engine lands?
open_questions.zh: 這次停用是永久的，還是等替代的 SQL 引擎落地後由 sqlExpressions toggle 重新開啟？

open_questions.text: After the backend is disabled, the frontend and query type schema still advertise the 'sql' expression type — is that acceptable?
open_questions.zh: 後端停用之後，前端與 query type schema 仍然對外宣告 sql 這個 expression type，可以接受嗎？

open_questions.text: Is the trimming of go.mod / go.sum / go.work.sum actually clean when a real build is run?
open_questions.zh: go.mod / go.sum / go.work.sum 的裁剪在真正 build 的時候是乾淨的嗎？
